setup.name: root-mount-setup
command:
import os,pathlib,subprocess,json
assert os.geteuid()==0
root=pathlib.Path('/run/hepta-daemon-learning-bfee5aa3-ff41-v2');root.mkdir(mode=0o700)
filesystem=pathlib.Path('/run/hepta-filesystem-bfee5aa3-ff41-v2');filesystem.mkdir(mode=0o755);filesystem.chmod(0o755)
metadata=filesystem.stat()
assert metadata.st_uid==0 and metadata.st_gid==0 and metadata.st_mode & 0o7777==0o755
for name in ['source','bind','witness-source','witness-bind','checkpoints']:(root/name).mkdir(mode=0o700)
for source,target in [('source','bind'),('witness-source','witness-bind')]:
 subprocess.run(['mount','--bind',str(root/source),str(root/target)],check=True)
 assert (root/source).stat().st_dev==(root/target).stat().st_dev
 assert (root/source).stat().st_ino==(root/target).stat().st_ino
rows=[line for line in pathlib.Path('/proc/self/mountinfo').read_text().splitlines() if str(root) in line]
assert len(rows)==2
print(json.dumps({'uid':os.geteuid(),'root':str(root),'actual_mountinfo':rows,
                  'filesystem_root':str(filesystem),'filesystem_custody':{'uid':metadata.st_uid,'gid':metadata.st_gid,'mode':metadata.st_mode & 0o7777,'device':metadata.st_dev,'inode':metadata.st_ino}}))
